question: The Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order (Amendment) Bill, 2024 is intended to add which of the following scheduled tribes to the list of Scheduled Tribes in Andhra Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khond Porja**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order (Amendment) Bill, **2024** seeks to amend the list of Scheduled Tribes in Andhra Pradesh. One of the notable additions is the inclusion of the **Khond Porja** tribe.
 
• The **Khond Porja** is an indigenous tribal community living predominantly in Andhra Pradesh. They are known for their unique traditions, culture, and social practices.
 
• The recognition of Khond Porja as a Scheduled Tribe provides them access to specific constitutional safeguards, reservations, and welfare schemes aimed at improving the socio-economic conditions of tribal communities. *Hence, the correct option is Khond Porja.*
 
• The addition of Khond Porja to the Scheduled Tribes list will ensure improved representation in government jobs, educational institutions, and legislative bodies, as per the provisions under **Article 342** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The list of Scheduled Tribes in each state is periodically revised to include or exclude communities based on their socio-economic status and cultural practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Scheduled Tribes and Constitutional Provisions:**

 
 
• **Scheduled Tribes** are recognized under **Article 342** of the Constitution of India. It defines Scheduled Tribes as specific communities that are deemed to require special attention and support from the government.
 
• The President of India specifies the Scheduled Tribes list for each state and union territory through public notification. Parliament may later amend this list.
 
 
 
• **Khond Porja Tribe:**
 
 
• The **Khond Porja** tribe is one of the many indigenous communities residing in Andhra Pradesh. They are primarily engaged in agricultural activities and exhibit distinct cultural practices.
 
• The inclusion of the Khond Porja tribe under Scheduled Tribes status will facilitate access to welfare schemes such as scholarships, healthcare, housing, and job reservations.
 
• **Example:** Welfare schemes like the **Post-Matric Scholarship** for Scheduled Tribe students aim to promote higher education among tribal communities.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Scheduled Tribes List:**
 
 
• The Scheduled Tribes list ensures the protection and preservation of tribal culture, languages, and rights while addressing socio-economic disparities.
 
• Being included in the Scheduled Tribes list enables communities like Khond Porja to demand representation in policy-making and governance structures.
 
• The government’s focus on tribal welfare is strengthened through measures like the **Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana** and other development programs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Role of Article 342:**

 
 
• **Article 342** empowers the President to specify the Scheduled Tribes in various states and union territories after consulting with the respective state governments.
 
• Parliament holds the authority to amend the Scheduled Tribes list as required to address changing socio-economic dynamics.
 
 
 
• **Scheduled Tribes Welfare in India:**
 
 
• Various constitutional safeguards and programs like **Article 15(4)** and **Article 46** ensure the promotion of educational and economic interests of Scheduled Tribes.
 
• The formation of tribal-dedicated ministries like the **Ministry of Tribal Affairs** has strengthened tribal welfare efforts in India.
 
• Legislative measures such as the **Forest Rights Act (2006)** aim to protect the rights of Scheduled Tribes over forest land and resources.
